text.en:
Barangays Payao, Calape, Guintolan, Balungisan, Balian, Katipunan, Labatan, Dalawe, San
Roque, Minundas, Sumilong, Upper Sumilong and Kulasian, all in the Municipality of Siay, Province of
Zamboanga del Sur, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a distinct and
independent municipality which is hereby created to be known as the Municipality of Payao without affecting
in any manner the legal existence of the Municipality of Siay. The new municipality shall be bounded as
"Starting form point 1, center of Steel Bridge over Sibuguey River of Pagadian-Zamboanga City Road; thence
the Southwesterly direction with an approximate distance of 26,000 with a bearing of S30_00'W until it
intersects the southernmost tip of Lacsico point called point No. 2, thence following the shoreline of Lacsico
Bay and Sibuguey Bay in a clockwise direction with an approximate distance of 50,500 meters until it
intersects the center of the mouth of the Sibuguey River called point No. 3; thence following the center of the
upstream course of Sibuguey River with an approximate distance of 17,400 meters until it intersects back to
point No. 1; the point beginning."
The seat of the government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Payao.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities shall be applicable to the Municipality of Payao.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Siay shall continue to perform
their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Payao until the municipal officials of said
municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall hold office until
their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipals officials following the issuance
of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the President. Such
appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organized or to complete the government personnel
of the Municipality of Payao shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Payao in the obligations, funds,
assets and other property of the Municipality of Siay shall be transferred by the President to the newly created

municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive orders regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 11th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Seven.
